# nymrel-crawler-mesh

> Zero-telemetry, high-throughput web crawler & semantic Markdown/JSON extractor built specifically for AI agents, LLM pipelines, and RAG architectures.

- Organization: Nymrel (Parent Entity: JalenBuilds LLC)
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-crawler-mesh
- License: MIT
- Runtimes: Node.js (TypeScript) & Python 3.9+
- Zero Telemetry: 100% local compute, no phone-home tracking.

## Core Capabilities

- **High-Throughput Crawling**: Asynchronous concurrency worker pool with FIFO queue, domain deduplication, and max-depth bounds.
- **Polite Rate Limiting**: Per-domain token bucket delay and exponential backoff with jitter on HTTP 429/503.
- **RFC 9309 Robots.txt**: Full support for wildcard `*` and `$` patterns, user-agent rule groups, crawl-delay, and sitemap discovery.
- **XML Sitemap Engine**: Automated ingestion of standard sitemaps and recursive `<sitemapindex>` hierarchies.
- **Clean Markdown AST Extractor**: Strips scripts, styles, navbars, ads, cookie banners, tracking pixels, and footers while preserving headings (`#`), tables (`|`), code blocks (````lang````), lists (`-`), and links (`[text](url)`).
- **SHA-256 Content-Hash Cache**: Automatic deduplication and HTTP 304 conditional request acceleration.

## Quick CLI Usage

```bash
# Crawl recursive domain
crawler-mesh crawl https://docs.example.com --max-depth 2 --output ./crawled

# Extract clean markdown from URL or HTML file
crawler-mesh extract https://example.com/article --format md

# Benchmark server throughput
crawler-mesh bench https://example.com --requests 50 --concurrency 10
```

## Quick SDK Usage

### TypeScript
```typescript
import { CrawlerMesh, extractMarkdown, crawlUrl } from '@nymrel/crawler-mesh';

const mesh = new CrawlerMesh({ maxConcurrency: 5, maxDepth: 2 });
const summary = await mesh.crawl('https://docs.example.com');
```

### Python
```python
from nymrel_crawler_mesh import CrawlerMesh, extract_markdown, crawl_url

mesh = CrawlerMesh(max_concurrency=5, max_depth=2)
summary = mesh.crawl_sync('https://docs.example.com')
```
